description: Blocks stacking puzzle where blocks are moved between table and stacks
layout: Blocks on table or stacked vertically
legend: Show block colors and arm state

critical_relations.on: block1 on block2 means block1 is stacked on top of block2 - draw vertically
critical_relations.on-table: block1 on-table means block1 is on the table surface
critical_relations.holding: arm holding block1 means the robot arm is holding block1 - draw near gripper
critical_relations.clear: block1 clear means nothing is on top of block1

positioning_rules: Blocks on table should be arranged horizontally
Stacked blocks should be drawn vertically with 'on' block above target
Held blocks should be shown near the robot arm/gripper
Use consistent block sizes for visual clarity

pick-up.description: When arm picks up a block from table
pick-up.visual: Block moves UP to gripper, arm closes around block
pick-up.code_hint: // Draw block at arm position, arm in 'gripping' state

put-down.description: When arm puts block down on table
put-down.visual: Block moves DOWN to table, arm opens
put-down.code_hint: // Draw block on table, arm in 'open' state

stack.description: When arm stacks block on another block
stack.visual: Block moves from arm to top of target block
stack.code_hint: // Draw block on top of target block, arm releases

unstack.description: When arm picks up block from stack
unstack.visual: Block moves UP from stack to gripper
unstack.code_hint: // Draw block at arm position, removed from stack

state_indicators.arm_holding: Arm gripper closed, block attached to arm
state_indicators.block_clear: No visual indicator needed (absence of block on top)
